topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: It's strange, the way things unfold. I always thought our conversations were just a web of words, light as air, floating between screens. But now, the paths of our lives have woven closer, tighter, than I ever imagined they could. I wasn’t ready for this, the reality of you being so near. It's as if the world has shifted, and I’m left to navigate the new terrain, unsure of my steps. I should have known, maybe, that the distance was a comfort, a buffer. Now, the thought of meeting you, of this world shrinking, makes my heart stutter. I hope you understand.
